note: Inputs for scripts/estimate-mainnet-budget.mjs. Gas units come from the read-only `deploy-rh-mainnet-full.mjs --plan` rehearsal of the ORION v1.0 deploy on a mainnet fork (58 transactions, 40,571,609 gas, 2026-11-03). Re-measure with `pnpm rh:mainnet:full:plan` before broadcasting.

calibration.basis: Measured, not assumed: eth_estimateGas on the live mainnet RPC for the nine implementation deployments came back at 1.009x the fork gas (13,580,486 vs 13,463,129; about 1.9 extra gas per byte for posting data to Ethereum). The earlier 1.56 factor was derived from a different rehearsal and overstated the cost by about 1.5x.

gasLineItems.name: ORION v1.0 deploy: registry, routers, vault, oracle, AutoProtect, 5 markets long+short, 5 margin routers, Uniswap V2 factory and 5 pools (58 tx)
Enablement: caps, pair funding, pool seeding, router authorization and unpause, market opening for 5 markets (about 55 tx, estimated)
Pons perp stack + market listing (v3.0, optional, 10 tx, earlier fork figure)

fixedEthLineItems.name: Operating reserve for keeper / Auto-Protect transactions (v2.0)

excluded: Seed liquidity tokens for the five v1.0 markets at micro size (about $5.4 of USDG and stock, bought with ETH by buy-mainnet-market-tokens.mjs; estimated, not rehearsed)
